# Public API that nothing in the tree reaches, one `path:name` line each.
#
# A ratchet: the list may only shrink. A new dead `pub fn` fails the gate, and
# so does leaving a line here after wiring the function up - the sibling
# `guards-are-reachable` learned that a one-directional ratchet is a to-do list
# nobody reads, and this file inherits that correction.
#
# The measure lives in `xtask/gates/src/gates/dead_pub_api.rs` and is stated
# there in full. Provenance, because the numbers do not line up on their face:
# `docs/AUDIT-DEAD-PUB-API-2026-09-10.md` recorded 205 dead of 1438 `pub fn`
# declarations at `8ebf838`. Re-running the rule as that report states it, with
# this gate's extractor at the same commit, measures 2037 declarations and 209
# unreferenced ones; counting distinct names instead of declarations gives 1536
# and 212. Neither path reproduces 1438/205, and the gap is not chased further
# here - a baseline that cannot be re-derived is a list, so this file is
# generated from the gate, not from the report. The difference from 209 is two
# adjustments: 13 entries added because `pub const fn` is walked here and was
# not in the audit's extractor, and 3 removed by the `WIRING:`-style exemption
# token. 209 + 13 - 3 = 219.
#
# Format: one `path:name` per line, sorted, byte order. Comments and blank
# lines are ignored; a line without a colon is an error, because a baseline
# entry the gate cannot match is an entry that never matches again.
